actions.add_permission.description: Shares a doc with a person (by email) or with everyone at an email domain.
actions.add_permission.props.docId.descr: The doc ID (for example AbC123xyZ) or the doc's browser link. Use List Docs to find it.
actions.add_permission.props.principal.d: For a person: their email, for example ada@example.com. For a domain: example.com.
actions.create-row.description: Creates a new row in the selected table.
actions.create-row.props.rowData.descrip: Define the data for the new row based on table columns.
actions.create_doc.description: Creates a new doc, either blank (optionally with a first page) or as a copy of an existing doc.
actions.create_doc.props.folderId.descri: Optional folder for the new doc (starts with "fl-"). Defaults to your "My docs" folder. Use List Folders to find it.
actions.create_doc.props.pageContent.des: Optional. Only used for a blank doc.
actions.create_doc.props.pageName.descri: Optional. Only used for a blank doc.
actions.create_doc.props.sourceDoc.descr: Optional. The doc to copy. Leave empty to create a blank doc.
actions.create_doc.props.waitForCompleti: Coda applies changes in the background. When on, the step waits up to 30 seconds until the change is applied; if it takes longer, the step still succeeds with Completed = false and you can check later with Get Mutation Status.
actions.create_page.description: Adds a new page to a doc, optionally under a parent page and with Markdown or HTML content.
actions.create_page.props.docId.descript: The doc ID (for example AbC123xyZ) or the doc's browser link. Use List Docs to find it.
actions.create_page.props.iconName.descr: A Coda icon name, for example "rocket".

actions.create_page.props.waitForComplet: Coda applies changes in the background. When on, the step waits up to 30 seconds until the change is applied; if it takes longer, the step still succeeds with Completed = false and you can check later with Get Mutation Status.
actions.create_rows.description: Adds one or more rows to a table, each given as column → value.
actions.create_rows.props.disableParsing: When on, Coda does not convert text like "5" or "2026-01-31" into numbers or dates.
actions.create_rows.props.docId.descript: The doc ID (for example AbC123xyZ) or the doc's browser link. Use List Docs to find it.
actions.create_rows.props.rows.descripti: A list of rows, each an object of column name or ID → value. Example: [{"Name": "Ada", "Amount": 5, "Done": false}]
The table ID (starts with "grid-" or "table-") or its exact name. IDs are safer: names can change or repeat. Use List Tables to find it.
actions.create_rows.props.waitForComplet: Coda applies changes in the background. When on, the step waits up to 30 seconds until the change is applied; if it takes longer, the step still succeeds with Completed = false and you can check later with Get Mutation Status.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
